scope: The next-season ledger (Cap Planning's 2027 total + the Cap Adjustments popup) now includes §F RULE 2 missed-nomination fines, not just drop penalties. A fine books TWO rows at the moment it's assessed — one for this season, one for next, same amount both times — and only the current-season half ever had a display surface. The popup's line-item label ('Drop · ...') was also hardcoded regardless of what kind of adjustment it was — a RULE 2 fine would have read as a drop. Both are fixed by the same worker route change, so nothing here needed a second implementation.
